scripts.dev: concurrently -k -r "wait-on tcp:5000 && npm run dev:backend " "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.release-final: tsx ./extra/test-docker.ts && tsx extra/update-version.ts && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:docker
scripts.release-beta: tsx ./extra/test-docker.ts && tsx extra/update-version.ts && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:docker-beta
scripts.build:docker-base: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge-base:base -f ./docker/Base.Dockerfile . --push --cache-from type=gha,scope=base --cache-to type=gha,mode=max,scope=base
scripts.build:docker: node ./extra/env2arg.js docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:latest -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:1 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:$VERSION -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:beta --target release -f ./docker/Dockerfile . --build-arg VERSION=$VERSION --push --cache-from type=gha,scope=release --cache-to type=gha,mode=max,scope=release
scripts.build:docker-beta: node ./extra/env2arg.js docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:beta -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:$VERSION --target release -f ./docker/Dockerfile . --build-arg VERSION=$VERSION --push --cache-from type=gha,scope=beta --cache-to type=gha,mode=max,scope=beta
scripts.build:healthcheck: docker buildx build -f docker/BuildHealthCheck.Dockerfile --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge-base:build-healthcheck . --push --cache-from type=gha,scope=healthcheck --cache-to type=gha,mode=max,scope=healthcheck
scripts.release-nightly: npm run build:frontend && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t ghcr.io/elephant-on-github/neo-dockge:nightly --target nightly -f ./docker/Dockerfile . --push
